title: Granite Springs Asset Management LLC Has $3.45 Million Holdings in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Granite Springs Asset Management LLC trimmed its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.4% during the second quarter, according to the company in its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 18,646 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 468 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 3.0% of Granite Springs Asset Management LLC’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd largest position. Granite Springs Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $3,452,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other large investors have also recently added to or reduced their stakes in the company. Prospera Financial Services Inc increased its stake in shares of Apple by 27.7% during the 2nd quarter. Prospera Financial Services Inc now owns 68,131 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $12,620,000 after acquiring an additional 14,799 shares during the last quarter. Tompkins Financial Corp increased its stake in shares of Apple by 1.3% during the 2nd quarter. Tompkins Financial Corp now owns 67,656 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $12,523,000 after acquiring an additional 895 shares during the last quarter. Jentner Corp acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at about $208,000. Westpac Banking Corp increased its stake in shares of Apple by 3.7% during the 2nd quarter. Westpac Banking Corp now owns 582,747 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $107,872,000 after acquiring an additional 20,750 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Pendal Group Ltd increased its stake in shares of Apple by 10.7% during the 2nd quarter. Pendal Group Ltd now owns 428,990 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $79,410,000 after acquiring an additional 41,347 shares during the last quarter. Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $222.11 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.84, a current ratio of 1.31 and a quick ratio of 1.24. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $150.24 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a market capitalization of $1,109.54 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 24.12, a PEG ratio of 1.99 and a beta of 1.36.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, July 31st. The iPhone maker reported $2.34 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, beating the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.18 by $0.16. Apple had a net margin of 21.98% and a return on equity of 43.50%. The company had revenue of $53.27 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $52.43 billion. During the same quarter last year, the company earned $1.67 earnings per share. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 17.3% on a year-over-year basis. On average, analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.76 EPS for the current fiscal year.
